svg.text: Buttons: one leg to GPIO, other leg to GND.
No resistors needed (pull-ups are inside the chip).
1. Pin numbers next to the box are the physical Pico pin numbers.
2. Switch: one leg to GPIO, other leg to GND. Pull-ups are inside the chip.
3. Sensor VCC must come from 3V3 OUT (pin 36), never from VBUS (5V).
4. Pico 2 W on-board LED is NOT on GPIO 25, so the status LED uses GPIO 22.
5. SPI mode 3, 2 MHz. CS idles high. MOTION is active-low (pull-up inside chip).
